metaData.originalTitle: 今年最值得升级的生产力工具，可能是一整张 AI 工位
metaData.title: The Most Worthwhile Productivity Upgrade This Year Might Be an Entire AI-Powered Workspace
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Based on real workflows, this article recommends AI tools like Gemini, Kimi, Feishu, Obsidian, Plaud, GPT-Image-2, TapNow, and Claude Code, emphasizing that the core of a workspace upgrade is optimizing the human-AI collaboration, not just piling on tools.
metaData.summary: Using the concept of an 'AI workspace,' the article outlines the combination of AI tools that the author's team frequently uses in their daily work and explains how they are embedded into specific workflows. It covers five areas: AI search (Gemini Deep Research + Kimi), knowledge management (Feishu + Obsidian), meeting minutes (Plaud), visual generation (GPT-Image-2 + TapNow), and AI coding (Claude Code, Codex). For each area, it provides reasons for tool selection, usage tips, and collaboration methods. The article concludes by shifting the focus back to the 'human' element, pointing out that the core of a workspace upgrade in the AI era is not accumulating tools but optimizing the human-AI collaboration, and it also recommends an ergonomic chair. The article is rich in real-world usage scenarios and specific techniques (e.g., customizing Plaud prompt templates, using Obsidian to build an AI understanding system), but the latter part contains noticeable product promotion content.

mainPoints.point: The core value of AI search is shifting from 'finding links' to 'mapping the territory'.
mainPoints.explanation: Gemini Deep Research is suitable for handling open-ended questions and automatically generating structured reports; Kimi excels at processing Chinese materials. Using them together can significantly reduce the time spent on preliminary information gathering.

mainPoints.point: The essence of knowledge management is building a system for AI to understand you.
mainPoints.explanation: Feishu manages dynamic information (meeting minutes, project progress), while Obsidian manages long-term accumulation (writing style, case studies). By using markdown files and API integration, AI can understand your context and rules before providing answers.

mainPoints.point: The true value of the Plaud meeting minutes tool lies in its customizable prompt templates.
mainPoints.explanation: Don't use the default template; instead, use prompts tailored to your role (e.g., for sales, 'Summarize by customer pain points'). The same recording can yield different perspectives.

mainPoints.point: The value of AI visual generation is quickly turning vague ideas into visible drafts.
mainPoints.explanation: GPT-Image-2 produces stable images, and TapNow supports video generation. They are not final-draft tools, but they can significantly reduce communication costs and rework.

mainPoints.point: The core of a workspace upgrade in the AI era is optimizing the human-AI collaboration.
mainPoints.explanation: Tools are responsible for recording, organizing, generating, and executing. Humans are responsible for judging, expressing, communicating, and creating. The significance of efficiency gains is to be less consumed by trivialities and to reserve energy for important matters.

keyQuotes: In the AI era, the most overrated thing is the tool, and the most underrated thing is the person.
A good workspace should help you get into work faster and recover from it more easily.
Tools are responsible for recording, organizing, generating, and executing. Humans are responsible for judging, expressing, communicating, and creating.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Engineering: How I Spent a Week Boosting AI Coding Rate to 90% in an Enterprise App
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically introduces Harness Engineering, a new AI coding paradigm that elevates the AI code rate of an enterprise Java application from 25% to over 90% by building a four-element system of rules, skills, knowledge, and change management.

relatedArticles.title: After Experiencing Tencent's Marvis Assistant, I Realize the Endgame of Personal AI is the Operating System
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent's Marvis assistant deeply integrates with the operating system's underlying layers through six out-of-the-box Agents, elevating personal AI from a Q&A interface to a device task scheduling layer, enabling system-level operations like file search, system configuration, and cross-device control via natural language.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Is Not the Goal, Knowledge Is the Moat — Knowledge Accumulation Practices of an AI Engineering Delivery Team
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on the engineering delivery practices of an AI Team, this article proposes that knowledge accumulation is more important than workflow orchestration, and systematically introduces a complete methodology encompassing a five-layer knowledge storage architecture, a three-level maturity system, and how workflows serve knowledge accumulation.

relatedArticles.title: Musk Spent $10 Billion to Figure Out One Thing: Not Building a Coding Agent Is a Death Sentence
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article thoroughly argues the core point that model providers must build their own coding agent products to obtain high-quality process supervision data and drive continuous model evolution, while analyzing the data game logic behind the $10 billion partnership between SpaceX and Cursor.

relatedArticles.title: Investing 10,000 RMB in AI: A Year of Tools, Practices, and Reflections
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: A systematic summary of a veteran developer's practical experience in the AI wave, covering everything from MAC toolchain optimization and Harness Engineering architectural constraints to building an Agent-driven automated learning loop.

relatedArticles.title: The Era of Super Individuals | Tencent Research Institute's 30,000-Word Report
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on field research and experiments, the Tencent Research Institute proposes that the core driving force of organizational change in the AI era is bottom-up emergence, with the central proposition being 'How do super individuals aggregate into super teams,' and systematically elaborates on the birth, aggregation paths, team forms, and operational mechanisms of super individuals.

relatedArticles.title: AI R&D Automation: Wiki Knowledge Base + Skill Pack
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how to build a continuously growing team knowledge base and a supporting expert skill pack based on the LLM-Wiki model and the Obsidian platform to achieve AI-driven R&D automation.

relatedArticles.title: Elon Musk weighs in! Kimi's paper challenges the 'ancestral foundation' of large models
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has released the 'Attention Residuals' technical report. By introducing attention mechanisms into deep residual connections, it challenges and reconstructs the underlying architecture that large models have relied on for a decade, significantly improving training efficiency.

relatedArticles.title: Google is 'Killing' Google with AI: This Keynote Was Overwhelming
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: At Google I/O 2026, the company unveiled the Gemini Omni world model, the ultra-fast Gemini 3.5 Flash model, the Antigravity 2.0 Agent development platform, the Gemini Spark personal Agent, and a new AI-powered search experience, marking a full-scale transition from free internet services to an AI subscription infrastructure.

relatedArticles.title: Dialogue with MiniMax's Zeyin: Agents Will Eventually Surpass Humans, Where Do We Go From Here?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Through an in-depth conversation with Zeyin, a MiniMax Agent R&D engineer, this article reveals the design philosophy and technical details of the Agent Team architecture, as well as the industry consensus and trend shifting from model competition to scaffolding competition in Agent engineering.
